title: How far above the LHC is the Planck energy?
caption: The LHC reaches about 10⁴ GeV. The unification energy (about 10¹⁶ GeV) is 12 orders of magnitude higher, and the Planck energy E_P ≈ 1.2 × 10¹⁹ GeV is about 15 orders above the LHC. Gravity's quantum effects are far beyond any accelerator.
alt: A logarithmic energy scale in GeV from 10 to the 2 up to 10 to the 20, with the LHC at 10 to the 4, grand unification at 10 to the 16 and the Planck energy at 1.2 times 10 to the 19.
description: Unification: about 10¹⁶ GeV, 12 orders above the LHC.
Planck energy: 1.2 × 10¹⁹ GeV, 15.1 orders above the LHC.
